digest.component_or_area: MCP tracker store; git push recovery; gate read-side validation
propositions: Deployed MCP server's tracker writes commit locally but cannot push to origin/tickets, stranding events in the container while returning success to the caller

Root cause is starvation under load: enrichment pipeline pushes every 2-4s while recovery (fetch+merge+push) takes 2.4-4.2s, making the race structurally unwinnable, not a wedged store or credential failure

Gate read paths (claim, plan-review close, completion close) must refuse to certify when reading from a stale store, using local staleness signals (push-pending marker or HEAD diverged from remote-tracking ref)

Backlog was reconciled without event loss; all ticket events either pushed to origin or compacted (non-durable enrichment queue entries only); ENV_ID_MISMATCH has no impact on production signing identity

Mitigation (overlap_drain off) reduced contention and allowed pushes to succeed; live validation confirmed MCP write to deployed server now reaches origin/tickets and is observable from independent reader
